question: What is PDFIndi?
answer:
PDFIndi is a 100% Made in India platform that offers free online PDF tools. We provide a complete suite of PDF solutions including:

  • PDF Converter Tools: PDF to Word, PDF to JPG, PDF to Excel, Word to PDF, JPG to PDF, and more
  • PDF Editing Tools: Merge PDF, Split PDF, Compress PDF, Rotate PDF, Edit PDF online
  • PDF Security Tools: Protect PDF, Unlock PDF, Add Watermark
  • Utility Tools: QR Code Generator, Password Generator, Image Compressor, and more

Built under the Make in India and Digital India initiatives, PDFIndi is designed to provide a secure, fast, and completely free alternative to foreign PDF tools. All processing is done securely, and we prioritize user privacy.
